items.evidence: theories/ExtractTradingChecked.v imports ExtrRustCheckedArith; rust/rocq_ffi/src/trading_checked.rs contains checked_add/checked_sub/checked_mul/checked_neg; python/rocq.py defaults checked=True on max_profit/max_drawdown/run_orders. New examples (Rle, ModExp, OrderFsm) are extracted checked-only (theories/Extract{Rle,ModExp,OrderFsm}.v). Safety batch (DriveModeFsm, HybridEnergyFsm, Pid, Hysteresis, Mpc, SensorFusion) extracted checked-only.

mp_bounded and mdd_bounded in theories/Trading.v bound the accumulators (m, b / peak, worst) by induction over the scans' own recursion, not just the results. Pid: raw_fits_i64 bounds each product and the pre-clamp sum; Mpc: square_le/cost_bounded chain; SensorFusion: gate_fits_i64 covers both gate additions.

safe_price_bound = 2^62-1 defined in theories/Trading.v; max_profit_fits_i64 / max_drawdown_fits_i64 closed under the global context (Print Assumptions); python/rocq.py SAFE_PRICE_BOUND mirrors it and _enforce_price_domain rejects with DomainError citing the theorem. ModExp: safe_modulus = 2^32 proved sufficient (square_fits, mixed_fits, pow_mod_lt in theories/ModExp.v), mirrored as rocq.SAFE_MODULUS and enforced with DomainError; m = 0 rejected (pow_mod_correct hypothesis). Pid: PID_GAIN_MAX/PID_ERR_MAX; Hysteresis: THERMO_T_MAX (step_fits_i64); Mpc: MPC_STATE_MAX + MPC_HORIZON_MAX; SensorFusion: 2^62-1 (gate_fits_i64 — the prover rejected 2^62: f+tol could equal 2^63, one past i64::MAX).

step computes `pos + qty` before range-checking; step_fits_i64 states the extra obligation limit + max|qty| <= i64_max; enforced in python/rocq.py run_orders. Contrast case: OrderFsm's guard compares before adding (fill_add_bounded), eliminating the obligation entirely — safe for all inputs. Pid raw is computed before the output clamp — discharged by raw_fits_i64. DriveModeFsm/HybridEnergyFsm avoid Z.abs/Z.opp on raw inputs (i64::MIN would panic checked negation): two-sided compares and constant regen instead.

run_orders_within_limit assumes -lim <= pos0 <= lim; python/rocq.py rejects limit < 0 (empty interval) and initial outside [-limit, limit] with ValueError before calling native code. pow_mod: m != 0 and m <= safe_modulus enforced; run_order_events: qty >= 0 (init_run_invariant). thermo_run enforces |t0| <= 2^62 (band_invariant needs entry only for the band claim; fits needs the bound); fuse rejects empty readings (median_in_inputs hypothesis) and tol < 0.

python/demo.py section 5: max_profit([-SAFE_PRICE_BOUND, SAFE_PRICE_BOUND]) = 9223372036854775806 matches the Python spec transliteration exactly at the proved boundary. pow_mod tested at exactly m = 2^32 (demo_more.py).

python/demo.py: 2000 random series vs naive O(n^2) spec for max_profit and max_drawdown, 2000 random order sequences vs naive gate, plus 2000 random sort lists vs sorted(); rust/trading_main.rs repeats this natively with 5000 trials. All pass as of this audit's toolchain. demo_more.py: 2000 RLE roundtrips (+ length-bound and counts-positive witnesses), 2000 pow_mod trials vs Python's pow(), 2000 adversarial FSM event streams (fills across full i64) vs reference. demo_safety.py: 2000-trial differential runs per FSM/controller (inputs across full i64 where the posture allows), MPC vs exhaustive 3^5 enumeration (300 trials), 2000 fusion scenes with minority-arbitrary faults checking majority_band and pairwise consistency at runtime.

rust/rocq_ffi/src/lib.rs wraps every call into extracted code in catch_unwind; status codes ROCQ_OK/ROCQ_ERR_NULL/ROCQ_ERR_PANIC; quiet panic hook with ROCQ_FFI_VERBOSE opt-out; demo layer-1 test observes RocqError instead of a crash.
python/rocq.py rejects float (TypeError, bool excluded via isinstance check), out-of-int64 (OverflowError); demo.py section 4 exercises all three rejections.
README section 'What is still trusted' names: extraction pretty-printer, remap table, FFI marshalling + ctypes packing, rustc/cargo.
